notes.text: R3 plan: inspect today's only guidance surfaces (hud-hint, hud-place, minimap). Implement the smallest coherent change that makes the active objective a named, findable place: objective text resolves to a place name; the minimap renders a readable marker at the active objective's location; an on-screen bearing indicator gives direction at gallop; arrival already fires placeLabel. Acceptance proof: traversal probe starts UN familiar with the map and reaches the objective using only these affordances (closed-loop steering, no debug warp); check contract extended; marker legibility checked on targeted captures; independent critic.

Implementation: mission stages carry placeId; missions.objectivePlace() resolves the active stage to a named POI ({name,x,z}), the same object the HUD target line (#objective-target: name + rounded range + 8-word bearing) and the minimap objective marker (paintObjective: ring + name label, edge chevron when off-view) render — one resolved place, three guidance surfaces reading it. New acceptance probe scripts/probe-travel.mjs: starts unfamiliar, uses ONLY the announced line + objectivePlace: reaches Harlan by expanding-ring hunt around the announced place, talks (E), mounts Juniper per the HUD hint, rides the announced places to the overlook (arrival event + toast), glasses the smoke, rides home and reports to Nell; target line retires when the loop closes. check-missions gains the place-resolution contract block.

R3 ride-probe stall root-caused: cabinTrail's POI-centre start bore straight through the ranch house and ended at its 0.9 m front door, which a horse wedges against forever; edge pricing only surcharges a collider crossing, so the graph plotted through the house. Fix: bend the trail west around the house. Routes from every yard pose now clear; check chain green.

steerRoute wedge root-caused with a traced live repro: an arrival inside the fort skipped the gate node at 14 m and the next hop's aim line clipped the wall's west end; the slide pinned the horse perpendicular to the wall face (err=0.00, d frozen at 9 m for 30 s) and steerTo's re-aim drag cancelled every shuffle's turn, while the retry's arrive-9 waive marked the hop done from 9 m short. Fixes: tail rule skips waypoints that step away from the leg's destination; gate nodes skip at 1.8 m only (chokepoints are threaded, not skipped); a wedged hop near a gate re-threads the gap at arrive 2.2 before re-centring. Headless full-world greedy walk and slope sampling both pass the same stretch, so the blocker was driver dynamics, not world geometry.

evidence.note: VERDICT: accept. All three criteria SUPPORT with line-cited evidence: (1) objectivePlace resolves each stage to placeId+approach (ranch.yard, overlook.overlook face 0); destination lines announce 'High Country Ranch - 10 m west - via the yard' and 'Ranch overlook - 0 m east - via the vantage'. (2) probe-travel run 9: 18 PASS / 0 FAIL - announce, talk, mount, ridden route with shrinking range (758 m to approach 11 m), arrival event + toast, glass beat (sawArson), return by name, Nell report, loop done:true, destination line retires, no page errors; screenshots confirm live rendering. (3) Probe drives only keyboard E/W/S/A/D and reads HUD/DOM; page.evaluate read-only; no teleport. Verifier not the builder (independent fresh agent). Caveat noted: earlier runs 5-8 failed on probe-side approach-tail steering; passing run supersedes; dismount-and-walk recovery is a player-replicable affordance.
